sourceDesign.provenanceNote: All 13 PAF-4 frames verified present in the current design (sha256 above) and exported at scale 1 (390-wide phone frames) from a temporary copy, so the source design stayed untouched. Double export of wHaAb/ENn8Q/eYIgj reproduced byte-identical PNGs. Frames taller than 844px (wHaAb 916, eYIgj 872, ENn8Q 920) are cropped to the top 390x844 viewport region; below-the-fold layout of those frames is covered by structural probes instead of pixel comparison. n6zFq (Shared screen states) is a 431x561 board of compact patterns, not a full screen: it is exported for provenance and drives structural assertions only, never a pixel budget.

recorded-empty-available.response.json.what: Byte-exact list_match_events(entry=available) server-function response captured after the same prune e2e/global-setup.ts performs (zero match events in the local loopback database).
recorded-empty-available.response.json.why: Available is a global listing; once any public event exists it cannot be truthfully emptied inside a combined suite run. The suite replays this recorded response at the network boundary so the empty-state rendering (real application code) is deterministic in any run order.

maskedAreas.policy: Masks cover only genuinely dynamic areas: venue-photo renderings (main img) and rendered start-instant text lines (first paragraph of each card / of the detail page / the review cutoff line). Whole fields, cards or sections are never masked.

scopeAdaptations.summary: The T04 implementation deliberately renders a strict subset of the designer frames. These omissions are scope-aligned adaptations recorded here and in the plan — not hidden visual defects — and the first-honest-comparison budgets below reflect them.
items: No Ranked/Unranked competition-status control and no Eligible League block (wHaAb, RDV2r, JLqMT): T04 has no Ranked/League state.
No public-match label on the 'Open to community' row (wHaAb): the visibility control offers exactly community_open and invite_only.
No filter chips (THIS WEEK/COMPETITIVE/MY LEVEL, This week/All types selects) on Available (ENn8Q, kYI9H): the listing contract has no filter set.
No date group headers or 'N open' counters on Available (ENn8Q): no fake counters.
No VIEW MATCH per-card action (ENn8Q): the whole card title is the link.
No SAVE control on create frames (wHaAb, vAxZh, b5RR4, RDV2r): wizard state is form-only; there are no persisted drafts.
No team assignment, no group format block (b5RR4): step 3 is the team-mode choice only.
No SET LIMIT / registration-order panel (vAxZh): maximum is a plain field and the FIFO rule renders as informational copy.
No photo hero overlay with venue name/description (JLqMT, eYIgj): detail renders the required photo, datetime, Maps link, price and notes as semantic fields.
No participants roster/grid or reserve queue (JLqMT, eYIgj): T04 shows accepted/playing/reserve/groups/more-needed counts only; detailed participant profiles are deferred.

No JOIN COMMUNITY TO PLAY / REQUEST TO PLAY registration actions (JLqMT, eYIgj) and no ACCEPT/DECLINE invitation actions (Fyhbv): T05 owns registration; T04 renders truthful informational approval/invitation context instead.
No result review, disputed/canceled/confirmed records or status variants beyond INVITED/RESERVE (uePpj, w25dY, t1ywa): T04 renders scheduled history only and never fabricates results.

No bottom navigation (Home/Matches/Community/Ranking/Profile) on any frame: the existing shell intentionally keeps working Matches/dashboard links instead of drawing inert destinations for screenshot parity.
The real shell renders language and theme selects above main; the design frames show neither (they show a LIGHT badge).
kYI9H 'Explore public communities' block: out of T04 scope; the app renders the localized empty copy plus the working create action (green primary) instead of the design's '+ CREATE A MATCH' tile.

knownDeviations.resolved: All previously recorded deviations are fixed and asserted exactly: exact-active tab aria-current="page" on the active tab only (asserted document-wide by assertTabSet); sub-44px controls (detail share-URL input, create file input, team-mode radio labels, invitee Remove buttons, unavailable Back link) all meet the 44px target via token styles (assertPrimaryHitTargets passes with zero exemptions); the focus ring measures the design-required 2px (--border-width-lg, attached to every keyboard probe); wizard photo previews render signed URLs with the 16/9 treatment. The F26-F30 reference-fidelity deltas are also FIXED and now gated at their exact reference values: 18px --space-18 gutter axis on list/detail/create (assertGutterAxis), 8px list/detail + 10px create rhythm (assertRhythm), white --color-surface pill on the 44px --color-surface-2 track (assertTabSet), exact --radius-12 card corners (assertCardGrouping), and the full-width --color-green 44px continue action on every wizard step (assertFullWidthPrimaryAction). Source-level only: the styles files still carry dead border shorthand declarations that StyleX drops at build time (finding F31) - the rendered cards are borderless, exactly like the reference. The primary-action copy token is now the reference-measured --color-bg (#f4f6f1, the exact second color inside the reference green blocks) on every green primary, asserted by assertPrimaryActionTokens.
knownDeviations.stateCaptures: state-loading.png and state-offline.png are (by construction) the same frozen viewport frame: the offline banner renders above the scrolled load-more region, so the viewport is unchanged when it appears; the offline state itself is asserted structurally (banner text visible, load-more disabled, error section present).

visualBudgets.policy: Reference-backed budgets equal the measured honest app-vs-Pencil diff ratio of the corrected implementation (copy-token + detail-restructure recalibration, VISUAL_CALIBRATE=1, recorded in measuredFirstComparison) plus a margin that only absorbs cross-renderer font-rasterization residuals (PAF-1 measured ~0.75-1.3pp absolute on text-dense screens): +2pp for screens measuring <20%, +1.5pp for screens measuring >=20%. Self-baselined viewports/locales/states keep a 2pp envelope around their first honest capture of the corrected implementation. Margins are never widened to hide a structural defect: every geometric attribute of the retained scope is gated exactly at its reference value by the structural probes, which now ALSO gate rendered geometry (getBoundingClientRect): the real vertical distance between consecutive sibling cards/sections equals the pinned token exactly, no rhythm child carries a vertical margin (gap-only spacing), and each rhythm container's content box wraps its children exactly (grouping boundaries) - see assertRhythm. So margin-driven spacing (gap+margin stacks) fails structurally and no budget can absorb it. The remaining allowance is cross-renderer font residuals plus the documented deliberate scope omissions only.

measuredFirstComparison.note: Measured against the implementation after the copy-token correction (primary-action copy --color-on-hero -> --color-bg, matching the reference-measured #f4f6f1 CTA copy) and the detail participation/participants section restructure. Detail budgets TIGHTENED versus the F26-F30 round because the corrected detail structure measures closer to the frames (detail-invitee 0.28 -> 0.21, detail-friendly-creator 0.40 -> 0.37, detail-public-guest 0.40 -> 0.36). Listing and create measurements are unchanged. Following the form-message UA-margin fix, create-review was re-measured at 0.29 with no structural violations; its budget is pinned at 0.305 (+1.5pp cross-renderer allowance).
measuredFirstComparison.calibratedAt: copy-token + detail-restructure recalibration run (branch feature/PAF-4-t04-create-and-discover-match-events), VISUAL_CALIBRATE=1, all 12 reference-backed screens force-measured in one pass; self-baselined screens re-captured as the first honest capture of the corrected implementation

visualBudgets.calibration: Measured on macOS (deviceScaleFactor 1) against the byte-identical double-exported Pencil references with only genuinely dynamic areas masked (venue photo renderings, rendered start-instant lines). VISUAL_CALIBRATE=1 force-measures EVERY reference-backed screen (budget 0 in calibration mode) and writes test-results/matches-visual-calibration.json; regular runs are hard gates at the pinned budgets.

referenceMeasurements.method: Measured from the exported reference PNGs (pixel analysis of e2e/references/paf-4/*.png) and the generated design tokens; asserted at runtime by the structural gates in matches-visual.spec.ts. Expectations are never derived from the implementation.
facts: Screen gutter: every frame aligns all content blocks to one shared horizontal axis inset exactly 18px per side at 390px (11/11 frames; modal content minX=18, maxX=371).

Cards and section surfaces: pure white #ffffff directly on the page background #f4f6f1 with no border pixel between (x=18 column transitions straight from background to white); corner profile reaches the full-left edge 12 rows below the card top, i.e. ~12px radius.

Vertical rhythm: sibling cards 8px apart on the listings (ENn8Q card extents 243..369 / 378..504), detail section cards 7-8px (eYIgj, JLqMT), create-flow section cards 10px (wHaAb extents 114..336 / 347..631 / 642..766).
Heading typography: h1 cap band 19-20px tall in every frame (ENn8Q/wHaAb y=25..44, eYIgj y=25..49 with descender) — only a 24px bold Manrope heading produces this among the token type scale.
Primary action: 44px-tall #0e714d (--color-green) blocks with white copy (wHaAb y=777..820, eYIgj y=749..792), full content width.
Selected tab (ENn8Q y=83..126): 44px track filled #e9efe8 (--palette-surface-2) with the active tab as the only white #ffffff pill on it; inactive labels plain.

Primary-action copy tone: the reference CTA blocks hold exactly two colors - the #0e714d fill and #f4f6f1 copy (pixel histogram of wHaAb y=787..810 and eYIgj y=749..792) - i.e. --color-bg, not pure white.

Rendered rhythm geometry: the structural gates measure getBoundingClientRect() distances between consecutive sibling cards/sections and require them to equal the pinned token exactly with zero margin contribution on every child, plus exact content-box wrap of each rhythm container (grouping boundaries).
deviations: F26-F30 (closed, fixed by the owning UI unit after the F18 re-gate): gutter axis now the exact 18px --space-18 token on all three surfaces; rhythm now --space-8 (list/detail) and --space-10 (create); the active tab is the white --color-surface pill on the full-width 44px --color-surface-2 track; card corners are --radius-12 exactly; the wizard continue action is the full-width --color-green 44px primary on every step. Each is asserted at its exact reference value by the structural gates, so no screenshot budget can absorb drift of these attributes.

F31 (open, minor, source hygiene only - no rendered delta): matches.styles.ts and create-match.styles.ts still declare  shorthands on cards/sections/surfaces, but StyleX cannot split a shorthand containing multiple var() substitutions and silently drops the declaration at build time, so NOTHING renders. The runtime is borderless - exactly the reference treatment - so this is dead code, not a visual deviation. Risk: a future conversion of the shorthand to longhands would introduce a border the reference does not have and assertCardGrouping (borderless, reference truth) would fail it. Remedy for the owning unit: delete the dead declarations (or convert deliberately with a design decision).

Residual-vs-omission breakdown of every remaining budget: (a) the dominant share is the deliberate scope omissions per scopeAdaptations (design blocks T04 does not render: filter chips, date group headers, rosters/queue, team assignment, registration/join actions, Ranked/League blocks, SAVE affordances, bottom navigation, photo-hero overlay, state-board rows, plus create steps rendering MORE retained fields than the frames); (b) cross-renderer font residuals ~0.75-1.3pp absorbed by the margin; (c) no open structural fidelity delta remains - F26-F30 are fixed and gated exactly, and F31 renders nothing. No portion of any budget covers an ungated structural attribute.
